title: AWS Modular VPC Template
description: Configurable Virtual Private Cloud with multi-AZ public and private subnets, Internet Gateway, and optional NAT Gateway

environment_name.title: Environment Name
environment_name.description: Identifier prefix applied to all VPC networking resources

vpc_cidr.title: VPC CIDR Block
vpc_cidr.description: IPv4 network range for the VPC (e.g. 10.0.0.0/16)

enable_nat_gateway.title: Enable NAT Gateway
enable_nat_gateway.description: Deploys a managed NAT Gateway for outbound internet access from private subnets (incurs additional AWS hourly cost)
